name: Peter Parker
tagline: The legendary original web-slinger who defined what it means to carry great responsibility.
biography: Bitten by a radioactive spider during a high school science demonstration, Queens native Peter Parker learned the hard lesson that with great power comes great responsibility. Serving as the primary anchor and mentor of the multiversal web, Peter balances scientific brilliance with unmatched perseverance.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Peter Parker in classic red and blue mask with prominent white lenses
suitNotes: Classic red & blue spandex weave with reinforced webbing grid, external wrist-mounted mechanical web-shooters, and high-tensile eye aperture lenses.

name: Miles Morales
tagline: Brooklyn's protector forging his own path with electrifying venom blasts and camouflage.
biography: Following the tragic fall of his universe's original Spider-Man, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales stepped into the mantle. Initially hesitant, Miles carved out his own distinctive identity, bringing cultural heart, instinctive musical rhythm, and unique bio-electrical abilities to the multiverse.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Miles Morales in black and crimson suit with spray-paint spider emblem
suitNotes: Custom spray-painted black tactical weave with crimson graffiti web motif and shock-absorbent urban sneakers.

name: Gwen Stacy
tagline: Drummer, hero, and dimension-hopping icon fighting with kinetic grace and rhythmic finesse.
biography: On Earth-65, Gwen Stacy was bitten by the genetically engineered spider instead of Peter Parker. As a talented drummer in 'The Mary Janes', Gwen combines rhythm, balletic aerial stunts, and interdimensional transit wristbands to safeguard innocent lives across alternate realities.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Gwen Stacy wearing white hood with deep magenta interior webbing and sleek mask
suitNotes: Aerodynamic white cowl hoodie lined with vibrant magenta webbing pattern, teal-accented stealth soles, and sleek frameless oculars.

name: Miguel O'Hara
tagline: Brilliant geneticist from Nueva York armed with plasma blades, fangs, and multiversal vigilance.
biography: In the cyberpunk megalopolis of Nueva York in the year 2099, Alchemax geneticist Miguel O'Hara had his DNA spliced with spider genes during a corporate sabotage attempt. Serious, uncompromising, and burdened by multiversal stability, Miguel leads operations to repair anomalies in the Web of Life and Destiny.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Miguel O'Hara with ferocious skull-spider crimson emblem and predatory visor
suitNotes: Unstable-molecule Day of the Dead weave with aggressive red death's-head arachnid sigil, holographic airfoil cape, and hard-light forearm spikes.

name: Peter Parker
tagline: A gritty Great Depression-era vigilante operating in shadow, smoke, and black-and-white cynicism.
biography: Set in New York City during the 1933 Great Depression, this version of Peter Parker was gifted spider powers by an ancient spider idol while investigating corrupt mob boss the Goblin. Dressed in trench coat, fedora, and aviator goggles, he hunts racketeers and crime bosses through the shadowy alleys of Manhattan.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Spider-Man Noir in fedora hat, trench coat collar, and stitched aviator goggles
suitNotes: WWI aviator goggles stitched onto a balaclava, wool fedora, heavy double-breasted trench coat, and vintage leather gun holster.

name: Peni Parker
tagline: Cybernetic prodigy telepathically bonded to a radioactive spider inside the SP//dr bipedal mech.
biography: Hailing from a futuristic anime-inspired Neo-Tokyo, young tech prodigy Peni Parker inherited the SP//dr mech suit project created by her father. Peni shares a psychic biological link with the central spider pilot housed inside the mech's cockpit, deploying high-tech web cables and tactical defense artillery.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Peni Parker with tech headset and glowing circular SP//dr mech visor silhouette
suitNotes: High-agility neural piloting school uniform paired with the spherical bipedal SP//dr chassis featuring illuminated multi-spectral optical clusters.

name: Peter Porker
tagline: An anthropomorphic spider bitten by a radioactive pig, armed with cartoon physics and giant mallets.
biography: Originally a spider living in the basement laboratory of brilliant scientist May Porker, Peter was bitten by May after she accidentally irradiated herself with an atomic hair dryer. Transforming into a porcine web-slinger, Spider-Ham battles cartoonish supervillains using slapstick physics, anvils, and irrepressible comic timing.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Peter Porker / Spider-Ham with signature snout mask and comic halftone backdrop
suitNotes: Classic webbed red-and-blue pattern tailored with wide ocular eye slits and custom reinforced dual-nostril pig snout mask.

name: Hobie Brown
tagline: Anarchist rebel smashing totalitarian regimes with distortion pedals, guitar solos, and spike-studded headgear.
biography: Fighting against President Norman Osborn's authoritarian regime on Earth-138, Hobie Brown leads the underground resistance with an electric guitar plugged into high-voltage amplifiers. Completely anti-fascist, anti-establishment, and anti-consistency, Hobie breaks rules across dimensions with effortless rebel cool.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Hobie Brown with metal spikes mohawk atop mask, denim vest collar, and jagged zine accents
suitNotes: Frayed denim battle jacket pinned with subversive patches, chrome mohawk spikes atop mask, and heavy combat lace-up boots.

name: Mayday Parker
tagline: The determined daughter of Peter and Mary Jane Parker carrying the family torch in the MC2 future.
biography: In the alternate future of Earth-982, May 'Mayday' Parker discovered her inherited spider-powers while playing in a high school basketball tournament. Wearing her Uncle Ben Reilly's costume, she stepped into the spotlight to defend New York when her father had retired from active frontline heroics.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Mayday Parker with dynamic narrow eye lenses and iconic bold web lines
suitNotes: Modified Ben Reilly scarlet-and-navy pattern with extended chest arachnid legs, contoured feminine cut, and streamlined gauntlets.

name: Ben Reilly
tagline: The courageous clone seeking his own destiny with impact webbing and iconic sleeveless hoodie style.
biography: Engineered as a clone of Peter Parker by the Jackal, Ben Reilly wandered the United States for years before adopting the Scarlet Spider moniker. Known for his raw determination, sleeveless denim hoodie, and signature micro-filament impact webbing, Ben proved time and again that courage is defined by choices, not origins.
alt: Stylized vector portrait of Ben Reilly in sleeveless blue hoodie over red suit with external wrist shooters
suitNotes: Sleeveless cobalt blue hoodie emblazoned with asymmetrical black spider icon worn over pure crimson bodysuit with external chrome wrist shooters.
